changeSet.author: FStavcev
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS migration_entity_map ( entity_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL ,source_id BIGINT NOT NULL ,target_id BIGINT NOT NULL ,source_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL ,updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL ,CONSTRAINT pk_migration_entity_map PRIMARY KEY (entity_type, source_id) ,CONSTRAINT uk_migration_entity_map_target UNIQUE (entity_type, target_id) ,CONSTRAINT ck_migration_entity_map_type CHECK (entity_type IN ('USER', 'ORDER')) );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS migration_entity_map CASCADE;
